title: Line length tradeoff between scanning performance and visual comfort
statement:
Web visual-search studies found a tradeoff in line length: longer lines improved scanning performance while shorter lines produced better subjective outcomes, so line width can be chosen according to whether fast scanning or visual comfort is the dominant goal.

Options:
- Comfort-focused: 55-65cpl (fits: comfortable, editorial)
- Balanced: 65-75cpl (fits: balanced, professional)
- Scan-friendly: 75-85cpl (fits: technical, high density)
- Wide scan: 85-95cpl (fits: data rich, newsroom)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general web, web apps, content sites. Audience: adults, general.

source.title: The influence of font type and line length on visual search and information retrieval in web pages
